description: Plan and inspect Dataverse apps using local blueprint and export checks.

defaultPrompt: Review my local Dataverse blueprint and solution export. Report missing components and runtime evidence.
Create a review-required blueprint for a Dataverse order-entry app with orders and order lines.
Generate synthetic preview data and a delivery review pack from my Dataverse blueprint.
interface.longDescription: Plan Microsoft Dataverse model-driven apps using local blueprints and exported solution files. Validate declared tables, columns, field types, relationships, forms, views, and navigation. Generate synthetic preview data and delivery review artifacts. This edition does not connect to customer environments or deploy changes. Generated checklists are not completed runtime tests. Local Python utilities require Python 3.11 or later.
